articles.title: Democrats killed the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: Democrats should remember the people they represent and do what's best for them, not what's best for their political calculus, consultants, and special interests, writes Sen. Tim Scott (R-S.C.).

articles.title: Crypto advocacy group announces picks for US Congress as midterms loom
articles.snippet: The organization’s endorsements in the House and Senate came as many polls showed Democrats favored to regain control of both chambers in 2027.

articles.title: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI
articles.snippet: The voluntary accord puts much of the responsibility for managing frontier AI risks on developers.
